knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A filter alone does not make the equipment approved for the material.
Wet methods bring runoff, slip and electrical hazards that need planning first.
Emptying a hazardous-dust collector needs training and an approved method.

practicalCriteria: Compares three equipment cards and a runoff route on a floor plan.
Rejects a household vacuum for a simulated silica task and quarantines it.
Records the chosen method, the approval and the water protections.
passRule: Household vacuum rejected for silica, runoff route planned, and the method and approval recorded. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Water used without a runoff plan
Suspected hazardous-dust collector emptied without training
